column1: # Rows 08-10 pin semantics the README states explicitly and a naive
# implementation gets wrong. They are not in the README's worked-examples table;
# they come from the "Glob/extension semantics" bullet in Matching semantics.

column3: leading **/ must match ZERO segments — **/*auth* has to select a repo-root auth.py, not just src/lib/auth.py
path_globs are case-insensitive — SRC/Routes/Admin.JS must match **/routes/**
test_globs and source_exts are case-insensitive — src/Foo.TEST.TS counts as a test change (README's own example), so qa is NOT selected despite a non-trivial 10-line source change in src/Foo.TS

each diff side is classified by ITS OWN path — the 8 removed lines belong to lib/calc.py (a source file) even though the file is renamed to notes/calc.txt, so they count toward non-trivial. Added by Codex review pass 1; before the fix this returned senior-dev only

column1: # Rows 12-13 pin the accepted diff *formats* (see README "Accepted diff formats").
# Both were added by Codex review pass 2, which found each silently yielding zero
# source lines — the worst failure mode for a checker meant to be a second opinion.

column3: git C-quotes a path containing a space; the quotes and the a//b/ prefix must be stripped, or the path stops matching source_exts and the rename's removed source lines vanish
a non-git unified diff has no `diff --git` line and appends a TAB-separated timestamp to each ---/+++ header; the timestamp must not become part of the path
